articles.summary: Lagos, Nigeria. March 22, 2022, As part of its commitment to empowering more Nigerians, stimulating economic activities, and widening the broadband envelope in Africa with affordable broadband connectivity, West Africa’s pioneer solar-based internet service provider, Tizeti, has partnered with Microsoft Corp. to roll out unlimited high-speed internet infrastructure in Nigeria starting with Oyo State. articles.title: Tizeti, Microsoft collaborate to boost high-speed internet in Nigeria with Airband initiative
